character_facts: The gray-haired speaker is politically assertive and asks for both economic and territorial concessions.
He has a son whose fortress is to be transferred stone by stone to a new planet.
Bari has two broken legs and is emotionally affected by the injury, according to the speaker.
The white-and-gold nobles speak in the name of the Emperor or imperial authority.
The baron is important enough that imperial representatives negotiate with him and address his demands directly.
characters_present: Dark-haired attendant or servant behind him
Two white-and-gold robed nobles, likely imperial or court figures
continuity_links: This page continues an ongoing negotiation rather than introducing it from scratch.
The reference to Bari's broken legs points to an earlier injury or prior event.
The promised trip to the Epyphyte sets up the next action in the sequence.
dialogue_meaning: The negotiator frames his side as loyal servants asking only for material compensation and territory.
He wants a fertile world so his son's stronghold can be relocated and rebuilt.
His additional personal demand is a morale-restoring gift for Bari after Bari's legs were broken.
The ruling side accepts the baron's demands conditionally: they will first travel to the Epyphyte, and the gift will follow.
locations: An ornate palace or court interior with stairs and columns
lore_facts: An Emperor exists and has authority to grant major demands.
A baron is negotiating directly or indirectly with imperial representatives.
Planets can be granted or reassigned as possessions.
A fortress can be moved and reconstructed on a new world.
A place or objective called the Epyphyte is important enough to take priority over the requested rewards.
Spacefaring travel between planets is routine in this setting.
Heavily armed armored guards are used in elite political settings.
plot_events: A speaker presents himself as a loyal servant and proposes a commercial arrangement based on a share of sales.
The same party asks for a new fertile planet where a fortress can be transferred and rebuilt.
Armed red-armored guards visibly secure the negotiation site.
The nobles question the request, prompting the speaker to specify an additional demand concerning Bari.
The speaker asks for a gift for Bari intended to restore joy lost after Bari's legs were broken.
One noble initially downplays the need for a present, framing discouragement as dishonorable.
The negotiation concludes with agreement that the Emperor will meet the baron's demands, but first the group must go to the Epyphyte.
uncertainties: The personal names of the on-page speakers other than Bari are not explicitly identifiable from this page alone.
The exact identity and nature of the Epyphyte are not explained on this page.
It is implied but not fully explicit which of the white-and-gold figures is speaking each line in the middle panels.
visual_summary: A negotiation scene alternates between an ornate palace or court interior and a space view of a large ship above a planet. A stern, gray-haired man and a dark-haired attendant address royalty while red-armored soldiers stand guard with heavy weapons. Two white-and-gold dressed nobles react to a request. In the final panel, a long spacecraft hangs over a planet as the speakers agree to travel to the 'Epyphyte' before a promised gift is delivered.
